title: On measurability of Kurzweil--Stieltjes integrable functions on compact lines
summary: We continue the study on Kurzweil--Stieltjes integration on compact lines initiated in [doi:10.1007/s11117-025-01161-9]. Given a real valued function $G$ on a compact line, the presented integral is called the Kurzweil--Stieltjes integral with respect to $G$, or simply the $G$-integral. %Given a compact line $K$ and a right-continuous function $G:K\to\mathbb{R}$ of bounded variation, we consider the Radon measure $μ_G$ naturally induced by $G$.
